notes: The catalog program page (ITCOMPSCBS) is script-rendered, so the required-course list was read from its embedded data: IT 168, IT 179, IT 180, IT 191, IT 214, IT 225, IT 261, IT 279, IT 326, IT 327, IT 328, IT 378, IT 383, IT 386 plus mathematics. IT 180 (C++) may be the intended CS1 for some students, since IT 279 names IT 180 or IT 226 as its prerequisite; IT 168 was kept because it is first in the sequence and is the prerequisite of IT 179. The program also has a General Computer Science Accelerated sequence, not examined. No public syllabus was found for any frame course; likely in a login-only LMS but not confirmed. Context: the university has a Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence statement (https://artificialintelligence.illinoisstate.edu/).
